expected_outputs.note: produced_by id-references are stable across path renames; legacy path-based linkage still works for v1.0.

handoff.note: Server-computed fields overwrite any user-supplied values on upload.
handoff.status_rejection: A handoff.status the schema accepts but the outcome enum does not (see status_refused_by_enum) is refused on the value's own merits. The value never reaches attempt.outcome: an attempt without an outcome is left without one, and an attempt that already has one keeps it unchanged. The value is never truncated to the column width, and never mapped to a nearby accepted value. The raw string stays in the stored manifest, and the upload response carries a 'handoff_value_not_in_enum' violation -- for every upload that declares one, whatever the column already holds. A value the schema itself refuses (status_rejected_by_schema) fails manifest validation upstream of this, so no sync runs and no 'handoff_value_not_in_enum' violation is reported for it.

formulas.ssim: score field as-is, capped at 0.3 contribution

metrics.guidance: Prefer numerical metrics computed on actual values over visual similarity. Image shape is easy to fake; computational results are not. SSIM contributions are clipped to 0.3 in result_fidelity.

scorecard.result_fidelity_formula: mean(deviations.score), with SSIM contributions clipped to 0.3 before averaging

status_machine.needs_review_means: Structurally complete, but held out of scoring pending a human: its trace cleared no admission signal, or could not be read in full. Not `incomplete` — no file is missing.
ready_requires: trace_admission.verdict != 'blocked' and != 'indeterminate', unless an operator released it (trace_admission.overridden_by_admin = true, set by allow_unadmitted_trace on the admin recompute endpoint)

recorder.install: git clone <repo> && cd tools/trace-record && bash install.sh

modes.live: PostToolUse hooks (Claude Code) / plugin (OpenCode) / git pre-commit (Cursor) / post-tool hook (OpenClaw) emit ARM steps as you work.
modes.post_hoc: Convert an existing native session log to trace.jsonl with `trace-record convert --tool auto --in <session>`.

recorder.name: trace-record
recorder.preflight: Run `trace-record validate trace/trace.jsonl` before bundling — mirrors the server checks above.
recorder.purpose: Produce ARM v1.1 compliant trace/trace.jsonl from native session logs of common agentic IDEs/CLIs.

admission.fail_closed: A trace the checker cannot read in full is `indeterminate` and held, not admitted.
admission.not_a_fraud_verdict: Each signal is individually cheap to fake. Clearing admission is not a finding that the trace is honest — that judgement belongs to the conviction layer, not to this gate.
admission.purpose: Floor for entering scoring at all, separate from the score above. A trace clearing no signal below does not reach `ready`; the bundle goes to `needs_review`.

checks.description: Every step must declare step_type in {thought,tool_call,tool_result,artifact,decision,error,observation}.
Each tool_call must have a matching tool_result with the same tool_call_id.
Step timestamps must fall within execution.ran_at ± wall_time_s.
Step_type=artifact rows must reference paths that exist in the bundle.
Total cost_usd must clear a 0.01 floor.
At least one step body must be greppable (substring) in execution/run.log.
